description: This PHP source file defines the class GridLayoutMetaDataParser, which handles parsing, manipulating, and converting layout metadata related to grid-based views in the SuiteCRM and SugarCRM systems. It manages layout panels, rows, and fields, supporting operations like adding/removing fields, managing tab configurations, and ensuring layout standards. The class interacts with implementation classes for deployed and undeployed metadata and provides methods for layout serialization, deserialization, and validation.

classes.name: GridLayoutMetaDataParser
classes.description: Handles parsing and management of grid layout metadata for views in SuiteCRM, supporting operations like layout serialization, deserialization, field management, tab configurations, and dependency handling. Extends AbstractMetaDataParser and implements MetaDataParserInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with view type, module name, and optional package; loads layout definitions and field definitions, standardizes labels, and prepares internal data structures.

methods.name: writeWorkingFile
methods.description: Saves the current layout configuration to a working metadata file, optionally populating fields from the request.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Deploys the current layout, optionally updating from the request, and activates the new layout.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout with filler and empty fields added for display.

methods.name: getTabDefs
methods.description: Returns the current tab configurations for panels, indicating if tabs are used and if panels are collapsed or expanded.

methods.name: setTabDefs
methods.description: Sets new tab configurations in the layout.

methods.name: getMaxColumns
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of columns allowed in the layout.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns a list of fields available for placement, excluding those already in the current view.

methods.name: getPanelDependency
methods.description: Returns dependency conditions for a specific panel.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a new field to the layout in the specified or first panel, inserting fillers or creating new rows as needed.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Removes all instances of a specified field from the layout, replacing with fillers and cleaning up empty rows.

methods.name: setPanelDependency
methods.description: Sets dependency conditions for a specific panel.

methods.name: getFirstNewPanelId
methods.description: Returns an unused panel ID number for creating new panels.

methods.name: _populateFromRequest
methods.description: Loads layout and field information from the request to update internal representations.

methods.name: _convertToCanonicalForm
methods.description: Converts internal layout format into the standard metadata format, filling in fillers and ensuring row consistency.

methods.name: _convertFromCanonicalForm
methods.description: Transforms standard layout format into the internal format, normalizing fillers and empty placeholders.

methods.name: getFieldsFromLayout
methods.description: Extracts and returns all fields used in a given layout definition.

methods.name: fieldIsRequired
methods.description: Checks whether a given field has a 'required' designation in its studio settings.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Filters and trims a field's definition array to only include relevant properties.

methods.name: getUseTabs
methods.description: Returns whether tabs are enabled in the layout.

methods.name: setUseTabs
methods.description: Enables or disables tabbed panels in the layout.

methods.name: getSyncDetailEditViews
methods.description: Checks if the detail and edit views are synchronized.

methods.name: setSyncDetailEditViews
methods.description: Sets whether the detail and edit views should be synchronized.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the implementation object managing layout file interactions.

methods.name: convertFromCanonicalForm
methods.description: Public wrapper for converting from the standard metadata format to the internal format.

methods.name: convertToCanonicalForm
methods.description: Public wrapper for converting from the internal format to the standard metadata format.

methods.name: getCalculatedFields
methods.description: Returns a list of fields marked as calculated with formulas.

methods.name: getFieldsInPanel
methods.description: Returns all fields within a specified panel, including nested structures.
